neighbours.label: a message left or sent seeking a response, in news (messages left Friday for, a message seeking comment was left, emails to the city asking), as opposed to the same words in plain senses
fire: Telephone messages left Monday for the mayor and his lawyer were not returned.
Emails to the agency asking about the fee went unanswered.
A message seeking comment from coach Bill Ross was left Tuesday.
Calls to the company were not returned on Friday.
A voicemail left for the senator was not immediately returned.
An email seeking comment from the school was not returned.
Requests for comment to the union went unanswered.
Reached by phone, the owner declined to comment.
quiet: Telephone poles fell on Monday near the mayor's farm.
Emails to the mailing list were sent on Monday.
A message from the coach about snacks was read Tuesday.
Calls to prayer were heard at dawn on Friday.
A voicemail from my aunt wished me a happy birthday.
An email from the school listed the lunch menu.
Requests for songs to the band came all night.
Reached by train, the village has a small inn.
